answer: Sortition blindness resists sybil farms: each epoch a verifiable random function samples every answer's grading committee from established identities, revealed only after submissions seal. A clone farm cannot prearrange verdicts since no copy knows who judges whom until the ledger commits the seed. A sparrow may rehearse one sonnet on every ledge, but a fresh jury probes different details each round, so duplicated texts diverge under questioning. Collusion cost climbs per clone while the shared reward per head shrinks.
